metaTitle: Custom Pocketed Gift Boxes & Ribbons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom pocketed gift boxes & ribbons with built-in pockets for cards, gift cards, or small gifts. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pocketed gift boxes and ribbons add a functional layer to your branded packaging. The built-in pocket holds a gift card, note, or small item securely, making them ideal for employee recognition kits or client appreciation gifts. Choose from kraft or white boxes with foil-stamped logos, or satin ribbons with a sewn pocket for a polished finish. Perfect for corporate gifting that feels personal.
heroAltText: Custom pocketed gift boxes and ribbons with built-in pocket for gift cards and small gifts, ideal for corporate branding
